weights (Objective.unweighted_se), while the prediction m_i is the mean of the reweighted blocks. This script loads the
R136 sample (32 replica blocks, generation 0), reproduces the sealed chi2 at the reported optimum, and recomputes the
objective with s_i from the spread of the reweighted blocks themselves, per segment, with the profiled scales.

templates = E.Templates(contract, 0, 0, E.load_fit_tables())
obj = E.Objective(templates, E.anchors(), fc_fixed=E.FC_DEFAULT)
print(f"loaded {templates.n_blocks} blocks in {time.time() - t0:.0f} s", flush=True)
fitted = rep["fitted"]

value, det = obj.evaluate(x, details=True)
print(f"chi2 at the optimum {value:.2f} (sealed 3153.6), one evaluation {time.time() - t0:.0f} s", flush=True)
phys = det["physical"]
weights, ess = obj.class_weights(phys["epsilon"], phys["b_sd"], phys["epsilon_nd"], None,

                                 f_tail=E.tail_of(phys))

    E = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(E)
    E.configure(R / "dev/mixing2006/config/runs/r136.json")
    return E


def one(f):
    E = _engine()
    rep = json.loads((RUN / "report.json").read_text())
    names = E.free_shape_names(f)
    x0 = E.x_from_physical({n: rep["fitted"][n] for n in names}, E.FC_DEFAULT, f)
    t0 = time.time()
    res = E._fit_worker(str(RUN), 0, 0, list(x0), None, 1500, E.FC_DEFAULT, E.DISCREPANCY, 6, E.NORM_FIXED, f)
    return {"f_isovector": f, "chi2": res["fun"], "nfev": res["nfev"], "converged": res["converged"],
            "x": [float(v) for v in res["x"]], "seconds": time.time() - t0}
